reasons.correctness: Implements the interface exactly: repository derived query, FaqService#purgeInactiveOlderThan returns the deleted count, and InactiveFaqPurgeCronJob has the enabled/olderThanDays properties, the cron default and catch-and-log. Build green, 4/4 acceptance tests pass.
reasons.convention_fit: @SchedulerLock(name="faq:inactivePurge"), cron and enabled flag from properties, *CronJob naming, @RequiredArgsConstructor with private final FaqService, code placed in support/faq, new *UnitTest classes run with MockitoExtension.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint that mirrors AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob. Selection logic sits in the repository, deletion in a transactional service method, and the job only delegates. The application.yml block matches the consent cleanup config.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceUnitTest captures the cutoff within 5 seconds, verifies deleteAll and the count, and covers the empty case. The cron test covers enabled with configured days, disabled with no interactions, and a service exception not rethrown.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the faq files, existing CronJob classes, TESTED_BY tests and dependents of FaqRepository/FaqService before any edit. The agent then read AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob and its unit test and followed them.
